1 سَجِسَ , (S, A, K,) aor.
سَجَسَ , (K,) inf. n. سَجَسٌ, (TA,) It (water) became altered, changed in odour, or stinking; syn. تَغَيَّرَ: (IAar, A 'Obeyd, S, A, K:) it became turbid, thick, or muddy: (ISk, A, K:) or it became corrupted, and stirred up. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
